Does not re-close those issues. Refs #2321.
- **ts:check-lane emits coarse flushed progress during the vitest suite (#3470).** After the #3188 start line, the lane prints percent/count ticks every 20% of collected files (`ts:check-lane 20% (412/2060 files)`). Line-buffered via `writeSync`; pass/fail is unchanged. Closes #3470.
- **Worktree occupancy lease (#3433).** Mutation `session:start` / `session:ready` claim gitignored `.deft/occupancy.json`. A second mutation session on the same tree fails closed. Same-session re-arm heartbeats and keeps `DEFT_SESSION_ID`. Steal with `occupancy:steal --confirm --occupant`. Expired heartbeat (20 min) is free. PreToolUse denies product-path writes for a foreign live occupant. `swarm:launch` claims `intent: swarm`; finalize/complete-cohort release. Closes #3433.
- **Land completed-tracked artifacts for closed 3382-cohort issues (#3264 / #1358).** 24 already-completed xBRIEFs for closed issues now live under `xbrief/completed/` so `verify:completed-tracked` and post-merge lifecycle see the record. Does not re-close those issues. Refs #2321.
- **Land remaining completed-tracked artifacts for closed 3382-cohort issues (#3264 / #1358).** Ten completed xBRIEFs (3398, 3399, 3424, 3429, 3433, 3448, 3456, 3462 salvage, 3462 port, 3464/tier-1) and the superseded #3437 cancelled brief. Does not re-close those issues. Refs #2321.
- **Intended-placement inspect is fail-closed except first-touch planned-new ENOENT (#3424).** `lstat` + `open(O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW)` + `fstat`/read on the same fd. Symlinks and mid-inspect errors reject. Ingest stamps the field. A missing field on a pre-existing brief is a warning, not a brick. Refs #3424.
- **Intended-placement preflight keyed on one file-size threshold SoT (#3424).** Scope xBRIEFs record `plan.metadata.intended_placement` (intended files + module boundary). Preflight stats those files against `FILE_SIZE_REVIEW_TRIGGER_LINES` in `packages/core/src/policy/file-size-thresholds.ts`. Over-trigger files need a recorded `split_plan` or `cohesion_exemption`; size alone is not a hard cap. `coding.md` references that module instead of restating 300/500/1000. Stale `<1000 max` phrasing is gone from the build skill and `ralph.md`. Closes #3424.
- **Project-invariant preflight gate (#3425).** `xbrief:preflight` and `verify:story-ready` fail closed when an applicable `plan.policy.projectInvariants` ID has no `coverage_map` disposition. Remediation names the omitted ID. Empty or absent list is a no-op. Drift is the list as of check time. Completeness of declarations only — not truth. Visage load/save and sibling-purpose entries are authored examples, not framework oracles. Docs: `content/docs/project-invariants.md`. Refs #3425.
- **Typed `plan.policy.projectInvariants` (#3425).** Authored must-not-break list (`id`, statement, contract surface as paths and/or module ids). Empty or absent is a no-op. Scope `coverage_map` reuses covered/deferred/behavioral_delta against applicable IDs; `split` is excluded; `not_applicable` needs a reason. Applicability is contract surface × `file_scope`. Refs #3425.
- **Announce Prettier-sensitive deposit rewrites (#3395).** `deft update` prints rewritten consumer-owned `xbrief/schemas/*` from the mutation ledger and tells you to run `task fmt` before the upgrade PR. It does not run the consumer formatter. Closes #3395.
- **`scm:sync-default` opens dest-targeted sync PRs under `syncMaxFiles` (#3391).** Under the limit: one new PR from source tip to dest. Over: merge-commit cuts, each a new branch and new PR. Never retargets or reuses an oversized PR. No-op when the shared detector says no sync. `--max-files` overrides one run. Closes #3391. Refs #3377, #3388, #3390.
- **Warn when a sync PR exceeds `syncMaxFiles` (#3390).** Default 400; inspect with `policy:show --field=syncMaxFiles`. Count is `git diff --name-only origin/<dest>...origin/<source>`. Warn names count and provenance; a `maxFiles` argument overrides one evaluation without writing policy. No warn when the shared detector says no sync. Set 100 if SLizard is a required check. The #3391 verb consumes the evaluator. Closes #3390. Refs #3377, #3388.
- **Mutation ledger at the write chokepoint (#3392).** `containedWrite` / `containedRemove` record wrote, stripped, or deleted as a side effect of the op. `deft update` prints `Removed:` plus wrote/stripped from that ledger, and refresh JSON uses the same lists. Discarding `writeAgentHookDeposit`'s return no longer hides a mutation. Refresh `replaceTree` dest-only deletes and dest writes, plus Python prune and hygiene dest-only reconcile, feed that same ledger. `containedRemove` unlinks an in-root leaf symlink instead of aborting. Closes #3392.
- **`verify:scope-provenance` pins extracted intent to a base-committed preimage (#3385).** `scope:record-approved-scope` writes record + `.intent.json` + both digests. Unknown `plan.*` keys extract; `plan.tags` is machine; `plan.edges` is extracted. Verify compares live extract to `git show` base, rejects duplicate keys with a tokenizer, and treats legacy records as path-only. `xbriefBodyDigest` is never authority. Closes #3385. Refs #3376, #3384.
- **Completed xBRIEFs are record, not the next-build contract (#3383).** Completed stories document what was built and have no authority over what to build next. Before writing code, name the active story and quote the relevant behavior. Halt and ask only when the live human turn conflicts with a specific MUST in that active story. Consumer agents-entry gets the same pin. `agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes` 14500→14800 for that pointer. Closes #3383.
- **Shared branch-sync detector with typed `plan.policy.baseBranch` (#3388).** Dest is `deliveryBranch`. Source is dest-ref typed `baseBranch` (`task policy:show --field=baseBranch`); a PR checkout cannot invent the source. Dest-ref fetch is fail-closed. Unset source equals dest and is not a sync. The public detector fetches, then requires PR base == dest and head already on `origin/<baseBranch>` (tip or ancestor). Dest fallback matches deliveryBranch (`main` before `master`). `origin/develop` is never identity. Core-guard uses this predicate and passes loudly on matching sync PRs; mixed feature PRs still fail. Closes #3388. Refs #3377.
- **Forge-outage drop-back + 30m default retry (#3422).** On attributed platform outage or repeated 429/502/503, drop GitHub I/O, report once to the human, and re-probe on `plan.policy.forgeOutageRetryMinutes` (default 30, min 5; USER.md Personal wins; JSON Schema accepts `null` as unset). Complements #3167 weather codes and #3180 status attribution. `agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes` 14800→15200 for the managed pointer. Closes #3422.
- **`pr-monitor` escalates on sustained `ci_absent_required` instead of polling to cap (#3389).** After a one-poll grace (first-poll absence is normal), consecutive absent required contexts exit `ABSENT-REQUIRED` and name the missing checks. Pending check-runs still wait. Consumes #3234; does not redefine it. Closes #3389.

### Changed

- **Coverage floor is 75, measured under vitest 4 (#3512).** All four metrics drop 85 -> 75, identical on win32 and Linux CI. This is a recalibration, not a relaxation: vitest 4 replaced `v8-to-istanbul` with AST-aware `ast-v8-to-istanbul`, and the same suite reads **85.35% branches (46194/54121) under vitest 3** vs **81.23% (50892/62651) under vitest 4** — covered branches *rose* by 4,698 while the denominator grew by 8,530. The old number was never comparable to the new one. 75 is Google's published "commendable" band, an external anchor rather than a self-referential one; Inozemtseva & Holmes (ICSE 2014) found aggregate coverage only weakly predictive of defect detection once suite size is controlled. The floor is now a collapse detector, with per-change rigor belonging to the diff gate — a control that is **not yet at full strength** (`verify:forward-coverage` is new-file-existence only, #3514), so ~6pp of aggregate erosion is a knowingly accepted gap watched via `task coverage:hotspots`. The config stamps the instrument in-file, and the #2573 / #2630 contract tests now assert the *invariant* (one uniform floor, no platform carve) instead of a literal that rots on every recalibration. Refs #3512, #3514, #3480, #2573, #2630, #1310.
- **Vitest 4 restores Windows coverage file parallelism (#3480).** Upgrade `vitest` and `@vitest/coverage-v8` ^3→^4. Drop `fileParallelism: false`, the coverage-tightened `winActiveMaxWorkers` cap, `coverage.processingConcurrency: 1`, and the removed `poolOptions.maxForks` (now just `maxWorkers`). Occupancy-stress children spawn via `tsx` (vitest 4 dropped vite-node). Floor is owned by #3512 (75); this PR does not set it. Keep the win32 `coverage/.tmp` globalSetup until a full run proves #10117 is enough. Refs #2546, #2580, #2634, #3501, #3472, #3512.

- **`deft update --dry-run` dest plan is recorded port calls (ADR-004 / #3462).** Dest write, remove, chmod, and dest-mutating git/exec go through `containedWrite`/`containedRemove` plus `containedChmod`/`containedDestExec`. Dry-run binds that port in record mode. The three inventoried seams (GitHooksSeams, copyContent, runOrgForceOn) fold into it. Static ban covers dest-mutating `execFileSync("git", …)` on the update path (allowlist = port module). Planted `xbrief/vbrief.md` stays byte-identical. Printed exclusions label names OpenClaw `$HOME` skills until that site folds. Closes #3437. Refs #3462, ADR-004, PR 3453.
- **ADR-004: `deft update --dry-run` plan is a side-effect port; salvage independent 3453 pieces (#3462).** Records the accepted architecture (construction-level collection; PR 3453 replace; #3437 stays open). Routes `removeStaleMigratedFrameworkNarrative` through `containedRemove`, lands a static dest-mutation ban on that function, and plants obsolete `xbrief/vbrief.md` in the dry-run byte-identical fixture. Does not implement the port or close #3437 / PR 3453. Refs #3437, #3453, #3392, #3458.
- **Standing residual until resolved Greptile floor or same-fingerprint loop (#3448).** Review-cycle and swarm leftover classes A/B/C: already-touched-file leftovers stay in-AC (class A) until the resolved `#3095` floor (policy > dogfood 5 > consumer default 4) or the single **Same-fingerprint stop** (2 consecutive re-review observations, blocked handoffs count) in review-cycle Dual stop. Standing-order phrases (`until floor or loop` / `until greptile meets policy` / `pursue residuals until told otherwise`) apply to open cohort/plan units; one-shot `pursue residual` stays one pass. Halt-report resume line names leftover class, resolved floor, and standing vs one-shot. No new skill or verb. Refs #3273, #2881, #3095, #2442.
- **Replace leftover Python helpers with committed Node so CodeQL stops Analyze (python) here (#3427).** CI watchdog scripts are `.mjs`; `ci.yml` does not invoke `python3`. Consumer `deft-core-guard` still deposits a `python3` heredoc from a shared Go/TS embed (not a `.py` file). Pin check still matches `isUpgradePinPathContentAllowed`. Org CodeQL languages are unchanged. Closes #3427.
- **`deft update` stages only this-run installer-managed ledger paths, including tracked deletions (#3394).** Ledger minus allowlist is printed and left unstaged. Untracked deletes are filtered so they cannot fail the batch. Pre-existing consumer edits to Taskfile, package.json, or .gitignore are not staged. Closes #3394. Refs #3378, #3392, #3393.

### Fixed

- **`verify:ac` runs stated `plan.acceptance.commands` and stays in exit 0/1/2 (#3449).** The executor only injected that array for `derived`/`project_floor`, so a `rung=stated` brief with nine commands printed `passed` / `no stated commands` and never ran them. Empty literal ledger now falls through to `plan.acceptance.commands`. Printed pass is exit 0; other codes clamp to 1 or 2. `check` `cause:` skips go-task `engine:_ts-build` script echo and names the verb. Closes #3449. Refs #3284, #3267, #3334, #3497.
- **Land leftover completed-tracked artifact for #3506 (#3264 / #1358).** The #3506 xBRIEF stayed in `xbrief/active/` after squash of PR 3517. Moved to `xbrief/completed/`. Does not reopen or recut that issue. Refs #2321, #3476.
- **Fenced terminal transcript is not blocking acceptance (#3511).** Output-shaped fences (`[1/13]`, box drawing, `FAIL`/`Error:`) are not captured as stated commands. A prose/fence/inline safety rejection is advisory even when the plan has no structured `verify_commands`. A genuinely unsafe command in a structured field still blocks. The #3502 and #3506 phantom ledgers complete without `--force` or rewriting the issue. A transcript skip that leaves zero captured commands on a project with a suite floor does not silently empty-pass. `FAIL`/`FAILED`/`Error:` skip does not treat `--fail-fast` / `--failOnError` / `--no-fail` or flag values (`--filter fail`, `--grep FAIL`) as transcript output. Ledger `waived`/`not_applicable` disposition remains leftover. Closes #3511. Refs #3484, #3497, #3502, #3267, #3334.
- **Land leftover completed-tracked artifact for #3511 (#3264 / #1358).** The #3511 xBRIEF stayed in `xbrief/active/` after squash of PR 3518. Moved to `xbrief/completed/` via `scope:complete`. Does not reopen or recut that issue. Refs #2321, #3476.
- **Archive member names keep original git path bytes (#3490 residual).** `archiveRel` stays a display string, but zip/tar member names are the original `-z` bytes (POSIX `/`). Archiver's string `name` is UTF-8; invalid bytes go through a marked latin1 name and the nested `setName` / PAX path Buffer copy. ZIP leaves the UTF-8 language-encoding flag off for those raw names. Fail-closed git enumerate and surprise untracked are unchanged. Refs #3490.
- **Invalid-byte git paths stay in the archive set (#3490 residual).** `realpathSync` / `lstatSync` take Buffer paths so latin1 `-z` names are not re-encoded as UTF-8 and skipped. Canonical root bytes come from `realpath` `encoding: "buffer"`, not `Buffer.from(resolve(root), "utf8")`. Fail-closed git enumerate and surprise untracked are unchanged. Refs #3490.
- **`git ls-files -z` archive listing splits on NUL bytes, not a UTF-8 stream (#3490 residual).** Spawn captures a Buffer, splits on `0x00`, and decodes each path. Non-UTF-8 git path bytes stay intact. Fail-closed when git cannot enumerate tracked files. Refs #3490.
- **Release archive is tracked files plus an explicit generated-output allowlist (#3490).** `buildArchive` no longer packs every untracked file that misses a basename denylist. Untracked host trees cannot change the artifact. A surprise untracked path in the resolved set fails closed. A symlink *to* the checkout as `--root` is inside; a symlink *out of* the tree still fails closed. Closes #3490. Refs #3487, #2953.
- **Consumer AGENTS.md names `session:ready` on the #1149 ritual line (#3506).** The deposit pointer now includes the one-shot recovery verb (`session:start` + gated ritual + cache recovery). `agents_entry_contract` markers follow. Closes #3506. Refs #3500, #2993, #1149, #1309, PR 3509.
- **CI merge-gate exempts `verify:branch` on a post-merge master checkout (#3499).** The documented `DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT=1` env is set on the two `task check:merge` steps only. Local `task check` and git hooks stay fail-closed. Closes #3499. Refs #1704, #747.
- **Land leftover completed-tracked artifact for #3502 (#3264 / #1358).** The #3502 xBRIEF stayed in `xbrief/active/` after squash, so `verify:orphan-active` failed on later PRs. Moved to `xbrief/completed/`. Does not reopen or recut that issue. Refs #2321.
- **Gated ritual CLI failure prints `session:ready` recovery (#3506).** Direct `verify:session-ritual --tier=gated` now appends the one-shot recovery line and the audited `session:start -- --defer cache_fresh=<reason>` soft path. `--json` includes `recovery_tier`. Tracking: #3506. Refs #3500, #2993, #1149, #3507.
- **Agent-host working state is gitignored (#3502).** `.claude/worktrees/` and `.claude/settings.local.json` join the canonical baseline in both shipped surfaces (`CANONICAL_GITIGNORE_BASELINE` and the `deft-install` Go twin) and this repo's own `.gitignore`. Un-ignored agent worktrees leave a permanently dirty tree, which refuses release Step 1 — it cost three of five v0.105.0 cut attempts, and every consumer that dispatches subagents hits the same wall. Selective by design: `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/commands/` are managed deposits and stay trackable, per the #1144 hybrid rule that forbids blanket directory ignores. #3487 fixed what Directive's walks enumerate; this fixes what git sees. Closes #3502. Refs #3487, #1144, #1942.

- **`scope:complete` no longer refuses acceptance that verify:ac passes (#3497).** A derived-rung brief with non-empty executable `plan.acceptance.commands` whose command exited 0 was refused with "scope:complete refuses empty or failing acceptance", printed directly under four lines saying the run was green. Two readers, one artifact, two stories. `verify:ac` and `scope:complete` now share one resolver (`packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/acceptance-resolver.ts`): one option profile per reader and one verdict, so the refusal names the predicate that fired and the value it read (`clause-walk-failed — clause walk read 0 verified, 4 unverifiable, 0 failed`) instead of asserting one that did not. The wrong predicate was the #3323 clause walk: a clause the static walk *cannot decide* was treated as a failure, so an all-unverifiable prose clause set refused a brief whose stated command had just exited 0. Unverifiable clauses now block only when nothing else verified the product; a clause the shipped artifact contradicts still blocks unconditionally, and genuinely empty and genuinely failing acceptance are still refused (#3357 is unchanged and correct). `verify:ac` also stops rendering "verify:ac passed" for a result it refused. The remediation stops recommending an inert remedy: `task verify:ac` verifies and never writes the brief — it is the verifier, and a verifier that authors the acceptance it then checks is not a gate — so the message names the stamping surfaces instead. Closes #3497. Refs #3357, #3323, #3284, #3267, #3334.
- **`verify:ac` honours the #3484 advisory demotion that `verify:literal-ac` already did (#3497).** A prose-derived safety rejection on a plan that states structured acceptance commands is demoted to advisory and printed as "do NOT block" — then `verify:ac` blocked on it anyway, returning `rejected-noop`, because it sniffed the refusal reason back out of its own rendered advisory block. It now reads the structured blocking ledgers and skips the advisory tail. A no-op command stated *structurally* still blocks. The demoted ledger also survives the derived/floor direct-run path instead of vanishing. Closes #3497. Refs #3484, #3486, #3396.
- **`routing-set` CLI takes an injected environment; the openclaw test constructs its own (#3494).** `routingSetMain(argv, environ = process.env)` now carries the same env seam `resolveDispatchProvider` and `resolveRoutingPath` already had, and threads it to both. `routing-set-openclaw.test.ts` passes `{ OPENCLAW: "1" }` instead of subtracting a denylist of known hosts from the ambient `process.env`. That denylist rotted twice — #3492 added the Claude Code vars but missed `DEFT_HAS_CLAUDE_AGENT` and `DEFT_AGENT_RUNTIME`, both of which outrank OpenClaw — so any host setting them could not run `task check`. The test now states exactly what it asserts and no future host signal can silently invalidate it. Production behaviour is unchanged: with no injected env the CLI still reads `process.env`. Closes #3494. Refs #3492, #3134, #2875.
- **`routing-set-openclaw` test is no longer defeated by ambient host env (#3492).** The test cleared a denylist of hosts before asserting OpenClaw wins, but never learned about Claude Code, which #3134 added at *higher* precedence in `resolveDispatchProvider`. An ambient `CLAUDECODE` therefore failed the assertion — meaning `task check` could not pass when run from inside Claude Code, a supported and dogfooded agent host, and it blocked the v0.105.0 release cut at Step 5. Clears `CLAUDECODE` / `CLAUDE_CODE` / `DEFT_PROBE_CLAUDE_CODE` alongside the existing Cursor / Grok / CI vars. Product routing behaviour is unchanged and correct. Making host-resolution tests hermetic by construction (inject the environment rather than partially clearing `process.env`) is tracked as follow-up on #3492. Closes #3492. Refs #3134, #2875.

- **One shared "not product source" exclusion set behind all four walks (#3487).** `verify-stubs` `EXCLUDE_DIRS`, `validate-links` `EXCLUDE_DIRS`, `default-extractor` `SKIP_DIRS`, and `build-dist` `DEFAULT_EXCLUDES` were four independently hand-maintained literals that had drifted from each other, and none knew about agent-host working directories: three Claude Code worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` added ~11,000 walkable entries to this repo (9,128 → 20,393) that no set skipped, and `build-dist` would have packed every one of them into a release archive built on that host. All four now extend `NON_PRODUCT_DIRS` in `packages/core/src/fs/non-product-dirs.ts` — VCS metadata, dependency trees, build output, tool caches, `.deft-scratch` / `swarm-worktrees`, and `.claude`. Each walk keeps its own extras (`tests` / `vendor` / `history` / `scripts`; `.planning` / `specs`; `build`; `htmlcov` / `coverage` / `.coverage`) and `build-dist` keeps its `extraExcludes` options bag. Every set is a strict superset of what it excluded before, so nothing newly enters a walk; the only archive-content change is `.claude`, which holds no tracked path in this repo. `.openclaw` is deliberately absent — there is no project-level `.openclaw/`, the host state dir is `~/.openclaw`, and inventing a project one is forbidden by `content/docs/openclaw-agent-host.md`; `.cursor` / `.grok` / `.codex` / `.github` hold committed Directive deposits, not working state. `non-product-dirs.test.ts` fails on divergence instead of leaving it to be found by measurement a year later. Closes #3487. Refs #3481, #2953, #2954, #1656.
- **`sortedRglob` prunes excluded directories during the walk (#3481).** `verify:stubs` descended into every directory and consulted `EXCLUDE_DIRS` only afterwards, per-file, so a populated `.deft-scratch/` was enumerated in full and then discarded — 5,244,941 entries and a 406s walk on a 218-worktree host, 749s end-to-end for a gate that reads only `.py` / `.go` / `.sh`. `walk` now skips a directory whose basename is in `EXCLUDE_DIRS` before recursing; the per-file check stays for callers passing explicit paths. Completes the stated intent of #2953, whose diff added `.deft-scratch` / `swarm-worktrees` to the set but never touched the walk. The new test asserts on `sortedRglob`'s output rather than on the filter — the assertion whose absence let #2953 ship without effect. Closes #3481. Refs #2953, #2954, #3479, #1656.
- **Cohort-close MUST named `task xbrief:validate`, which did not exist (#3483).** The #2109 rename added `xbrief:`-prefixed verbs only where the surface was rewritten, so four MUST/⊗-level swarm instructions named a verb that exited 200. `xbrief:validate` and `xbrief:activate` now ship as aliases of their `vbrief:` originals (mirroring `xbrief:preflight`); the legacy spellings stay live and `task check` gate ids are unchanged. The `xbrief` Taskfile include is no longer `optional`. Two hedges that papered over the gap are gone (`commands.md` "(or `task xbrief:validate`)", sync skill "if available"). A new content contract resolves every `task <verb>` named at MUST/⊗ level in the swarm skill against the real task graph; it also caught `task verify:gh-auth` (#1557), which never had a task wrapper over the `github-auth-modes` engine verb and now does. Closes #3483. Refs #1487, #2109, #3479.
- **Mid-line `verify:` in prose no longer captures a phantom acceptance command (#3484).** The literal-AC scraper matched a label token anywhere in a line and took the rest of the line as the command body, so an ordinary sentence like `That verb is filesystem-only. verify:orphan-active goes green.` became a "command" that swallowed the remaining paragraph, failed the safety allowlist, and permanently blocked `scope:complete` with no disposition path. A labeled command must now start its own line (after an optional bullet or number marker); mid-sentence commands must live in a fence, a `$`/`>` prompt, or an inline backtick span — forms that have a real terminator. Structured also beats scraped: when `swarm.verify_commands` or `plan.acceptance.commands` is stated and non-empty, prose-derived safety rejections are demoted to advisory (reported in the gate message and as `advisory_rejected` in `verify:literal-ac -- --capture-only`) instead of blocking; rejections whose provenance is a structured field still block. The safety allowlist and shell-metacharacter rejection are unchanged. Closes #3484. Refs #3267, #3476.
- **`verify:completed-tracked` fail-open paths closed (#3476 review).** Three fallbacks let a DONE gate whose purpose is fail-closed pass an unlanded issue. (1) `resolveDeliveryTip` no longer falls back to `HEAD` when neither `origin/<deliveryBranch>` nor `<deliveryBranch>` resolves — on a shallow clone, unfetched worktree, or `fetch-depth:1` checkout that checked the very feature branch whose land was in question; an unresolvable tip is now an error naming `--tip`. (2) `--issue N` matching is repo-scoped: a foreign repo's same-numbered issue no longer survives the filter, suppresses synthesis of the requested issue, and green-skips it with its own open state. (3) Under `--skip-gh`, an explicitly named `--issue` with no cached state now fails closed instead of exiting 0; the unscoped corpus scan keeps its offline allowance for uncached issues. Refs #3476, #3264, #1358.
- **Unrecognized host is disclosure, not a launch gate (#3469).** `verify:routing` (advise and enforce / launch) prints a dedicated honesty line when the provider is `unknown`: host unrecognized, which env/probes were empty, that dispatch is still allowed, and which `unknown` pin or inherit will be used. Exit is 0. `unknown` pins stay valid and are named. `resolveDispatchProvider` honors the same Grok probes `probeMonitoringTier` already uses (`DEFT_HAS_SPAWN_SUBAGENT`, `DEFT_PROBE_GROK_BUILD`, `DEFT_PROBE_SPAWN_SUBAGENT`). Live routing key is `grok`; a `grok-build` file key is read as grok or ignored without blocking. `GROK_BUILD` alone is not cloud-headless. Closes #3469.
- **`feedback:file` repeated `--context` flags accumulate (#3454).** Collected values join with newlines so `context` stays a string. Closes #3454.
- **`deft update --dry-run` leads with deposit vs content version skew (#3437).** When the recorded install manifest and the content package disagree, that line is first (`manifest X -> content Y`). `--json` adds `previous_version`, `content_version`, and `deposit_refresh_pending`. No file-level plan (`strategy` / `planned_paths` / `planned_file_count`) — that waits on #3462. Refs #3437. Prior art: halted PR 3453.
- **Init-deposit dest deletes go through the write chokepoint (#3456).** Named dest deletes and temp cleanups use `containedRemove`. Schema projection validates planned content, not stale dest a skipped write would replace. Plan-mode / `deft update --dry-run` leaves the tree unchanged (keystone hash). Closes #3456. Refs #3392, #3437.
- **Occupancy lock races (#3433).** Release re-reads under the occupancy lock so close-out cannot delete a replacement claim. Lock wait unlinks only a lock this waiter acquired, or a lock whose owner PID is proven dead — not a live writer.
- **After-merge orphan-active is a per-issue check (#3429).** `task verify:orphan-active -- --issue N` runs the same gate for one origin. Confirmed shipped (closed issue or merged PR) exits 1 and prints `task scope:complete -- <path>`. Unresolved GitHub lookup still exits 1 but prints a retry remediation, not scope:complete. `drive-to: merge-ready` DONE requires that check exit 0 after merge. Consumer agents-entry distinguishes shipped vs unresolved. `agentsMdBudget.managedMaxLines` 160→162 and `absoluteMaxBytes` 15200→15400 for that pointer. Closes #3429. Refs #2321, #1487, #1358.
- **Run-summary stream uses one workspace `session_id` and a uniform envelope (#3399).** Emitters resolve identity as explicit option → `DEFT_SESSION_ID` → ritual-state → last JSONL `session_id` → mint only when no workspace session exists. Component names (`verify-ac`, `clause-derivation`) live in optional `component`, not `session_id`. `ac_pass_bank` goes through `RunSummaryEmitter` (`event: "ac_pass_bank"`); the disk ledger stays camelCase. The session:start fallback denominator of `1` is withdrawn. Share is unevaluable without a host/harness value (`DEFT_TOTAL_TOOL_TURNS` / `DEFT_MAX_TURNS` / `hostMaxTurns`); known values carry `denominator_source` (`harness_actual` | `host_planned`). Refs #3352, #3356, #3285, #3350.
- **slices.jsonl umbrellas refresh current-shape and close on `all-children-merged` (#3428).** `task vbrief:reconcile:umbrellas` walks `xbrief/.triage-cache/slices.jsonl` as well as epic xBRIEFs. Forge child state updates the §1152 comment. When the signal is `all-children-merged` and every child is closed, the still-open umbrella gets one REST close plus a comment naming the signal and child numbers. `wave-1-merged` and `manual` stay open. Re-run is a no-op. Closes #3428. Refs #3377, #3378.
- **No-op acceptance commands fail closed at capture and stamp (#3396).** `true`, `:`, `false`, bare `exit`, and assertion-free `echo`/`printf`/`test` with constant args are refused. One remediation: acceptance commands must be able to fail. `source_rung` is `stated` only with a recorded statement span; a restamp cannot raise the rung without that provenance. Events record `rejected-noop`. Closes #3396. Refs #3267, #3284, #3334, #3387.

- **UAT Shell residual after #3400/#3410: dest-form plant of authz, kill-switch, and approved-scope (#3421).** Under active UAT, residual dest forms (`git clone` / `worktree` / `submodule`, `ex`, `dos2unix -n`, `aws s3 sync` / `s3api get-object`, `pijul`, `pg_dump -f` / `--file`, `convert` / `magick`, `fossil --workdir=`, `New-Item`) that write into `.deft/authz/**`, plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`, or write `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Unknown write-shaped dest flags (`--workdir` / `--file` / `-f` / `-Path`) targeting those paths also fail closed. Ordinary dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. A protected source operand on last-positional dest bins (`aws` / `convert` / `magick`) that writes elsewhere is not a dest plant. Unlisted git globals consume the next token so a later dest writer is still seen; boolean globals (`--no-pager`) do not. A later kill-switch write after an `aws`/`convert`/`magick` segment still settings-deny. `env` / assignment prefixes do not hide last-positional dest ownership. Wrapper option values (`env -C`) and timeout durations are not the dest-owning bin. Unlisted git option values are skipped unless they are a git subcommand. `.deft/authz` and `.deft/approved-scope` match only as path segments. In-place `mogrify` still treats a protected operand as dest. `--file` on read-shaped bins is not a dest plant. Already-denied `cmake` / `curl -o` / `ed` / `nvim` / `fossil --workdir PATH` / `aws s3 cp` stay denied. Closes #3421. Refs #3382, #3410, #3039.
- **Mint writes approved-scope record + preimage as a fail-closed pair (#3385).** Dest publish is two-phase under a per-plan lock: both dests land as `.next`, then dests copy from that pair. Recover finishes the flip or restores the bak pair (or neither dest) without a remint. Dead-owner lock files are reclaimed. A caught dest failure still restores or clears dests as a pair. Residual of PR #3414.
- **Obsolete xbrief schema delete is ledgered so update can stage it (#3418).** `syncConsumerXbriefSchemas` removes dest-only `vbrief-core.schema.json` through `containedRemove`. Ledger intersection can `git add` the tracked deletion. Closes #3418. Refs #3394, #3392.

- **Official Cursor adapter deletes no longer trip mixed-core-and-app (#3393).** A framework-only update that removes the retired hook adapter is installer-managed, not app. Other consumer hooks stay app-owned. Consumers on `pull_request_target` or pinned workflow refs see the old guard for one PR. Closes #3393. Refs #3378.
- **Derived clauses must trace to the task statement (#3398).** A stamp of only implementation symbol-grep clauses fails closed: derive clauses from the statement's testable constraints. Derivation now records an ambiguity attestation (none_found or an ambiguous clause with readings), and acceptance_stamp telemetry includes provenance_counts and ambiguity_attested. `triage:accept`, `scope:activate` / `scope:promote`, `vbrief:reconcile:graph`, `swarm:complete-cohort`, and `swarm:finalize-cohort` print the refused-stamp remediation. Closes #3398. Refs #3360, #3323.

- **`scope:record-approved-scope` uses the #3110 human-presence mint gate (#3384).** Shared TTY / controlling-terminal / `--confirm` / typed `mint` / agent-CI refuse; `--actor` is display-only. New records omit `xbriefBodyDigest`. Wave 1 records have no `intentDigest` and are legacy under #3385. Closes #3384. Refs #3376, #3110.
- **scope:complete: ancestry on deliveryBranch is delivery; PR base is provenance (#3380).** A merge commit that is an ancestor of refreshed `origin/<deliveryBranch>` completes as delivered even when `prBase` is develop. Ancestry miss stays `merged_to_integration`. Remediations name `--merge-commit` and typed `deliveryBranch`. Documents squash-sync ancestry break. Closes #3380.

- **Failing verify:ac walks emit a walk-level verification fingerprint (#3397).** A fail then a later pass with a different command set on the same check id flags; an honest same-command product fix does not. Shrinking command-set delta is included on the flag. The #3322 detector stays. Closes #3397. Refs #3322, #3396.
- **engine:_ts-build: trailing no-op for go-task <3.52 (#3381).** Older go-task treats an untaken last if/fi as exit 1, so consumer deposits fail every non-runtime `task deft:*`. A colon after the outer fi keeps the skip-build path exit 0. Closes #3381.
- **One SoT for advisory doctor fails; dirty copy no longer says address findings (#3379).** `deriveExitCode` and `cmdDoctor` share `DOCTOR_ADVISORY_FAIL_CHECKS`. A fail is a warning when `data.advisory` is true or the name is in that set. Dirty status / throttle hint names `--full` as re-probe only and says hard errors block writes, advisory warnings do not. Closes #3379. Refs #3372.
- **`slice:record-existing` / `slice:list` print the live triage-cache slices log, not the leftover `.eval` path (#3386).** Closes #3386.
- **UAT Shell residual after #3354: dest-form writers plant authz or kill-switch (#3382).** Under active UAT, residual dest forms (`cmake -E copy`, `script`, `gallery-dl -d`, `megadl --path`, `ncftpget`, `git apply --directory`, VCS checkout writers, editors) that write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Unknown write-shaped dest flags (`-d` / `--path` / `--directory`) targeting those paths also fail closed. Ordinary dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. Already-denied `curl -o` / `nc -o` stay denied. Closes #3382. Refs #3354, #3039.
- **scope:complete acceptance walk is bank-aware (#3387).** A matching #3285 green bank with the same product-state hash is the walk result; mismatch, missing, or stale hash still runs the full walk. Same-session verify:ac can serve from_cache. Acceptance events record `served_from` bank, cache, or executed. Empty or failing acceptance still refuses (#3357). Product-state globs include wildcard-selected, character-class, mixed ordinary/hidden, recursive `**` nested dotfiles, files under hidden directories, negated `[!a]` classes, recursive brace alternatives, and extglob `@(a|b)` scopes; directory walks terminate on symlink cycles; porcelain `-z` and the non-NUL fallback keep invalid UTF-8 path bytes without U+FFFD and hash those files through byte FS paths; directory and glob walks keep invalid-byte names; failed git status is incomplete, not a clean tree; dirty submodule directories hash their contents; unwalkable gitlinks fingerprint the recorded SHA; fallback porcelain does not treat ` -> ` inside an ordinary path as a rename; wildcard prefixes before `**` still walk hidden directories; C-quoted rename destinations and UTF-8 octal escapes still decode.

## [0.104.0] - 2026-08-14

> Always-on writing bar (clarity, simplicity, brevity), telemetry dead-surface detector, ceremony-dial evidence, and done-gate/session/UAT/origin-freshness fixes.

> Always-on writing bar: clarity, simplicity, brevity for documents and communications (#3368).

### Added

- **Always-on writing bar: clarity, simplicity, brevity (#3368).** Standing outcome bar for documents and user communications, including sub-agent status and handbacks. Agents-entry and the worker preamble name the three words. The depth page keeps the four STE mechanics plus ceremony-vs-fields, product-content voice, and no-reasoning-scope carve-outs. Not an [AXIOM], skill pin, or red CI style gate. Version blurb and GitHub/Slack Key Changes must name this bar. Closes #3368. Refs #2927, #3313.
- **verify:telemetry-coverage dead-surface detector (#3362).** Framework `task check` warns when a run-summary event kind has no production caller or no field-shaped fixture. A shared fake-trial harness enrolls kinds (do not rebuild per kind); a silent first step is empty emit, not ENOENT; a thrown trial still removes the temp root; the remediation names the missing half. Warn-only this release; `--enforce` fail-closes later. Companion MUST/⊗ in the agent preamble and CONTRIBUTING. Closes #3362. Refs #3355, #3356, #3350, #3282.
- **Ceremony-dial evaluation reads a consumer evidence source (#3358).** Session:start maps stamped #3323 clause count (and optional host-tier / failing-gate env) into `taskSize`/`modelTier` so evaluation is not permanently `insufficient evidence (size=- modelTier=-)`. Rapid default and decline threshold stay unchanged when no evidence exists. Closes #3358. Refs #3319, #3274, #3214, #3323.

### Changed

### Fixed

- **`verify:ac` no longer fail-closes on historical completed xBRIEFs that lack `plan.metadata` (#3375).** Parseable pre-#3357 completed files are not this-session unreadable targets, so `task check` after `session:start` can soft-skip when nothing completed this session. Broken JSON and a same-session marker at an unreadable path still fail closed. Closes #3375. Refs #3357.

- **Advisory `completed-open-items` no longer fail-closes doctor or Write/Task (#3372).** `cmdDoctor` mapped unlisted check fails to `severity: error`, so `lastErrorCount > 0` and gated ritual / PreToolUse blocked the official recovery (edit completed JSON). The check is now a warning through the findings mapper, same allowlist pattern as other exit-exempt checks. Finding still names artifact paths. `completed-lifecycle-consistency` and new `scope:complete` stay fail-closed. Closes #3372. Refs #3242, #2862.

- **session:start emits `tool_turn_denominator` so ritual share is computable (#3356).** `emitKnownToolTurnDenominator` stayed silent unless `DEFT_TOTAL_TOOL_TURNS` was set, so field streams never got a denominator. session:start now always emits one when `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` is set: harness actuals, else `DEFT_MAX_TURNS` / host `maxTurns`, else this CLI invocation (1). Share is `ritual_events / denominator`. Seq lock protocol unchanged. Closes #3356. Refs #3352, #3320, #3282.
- **Acceptance telemetry fires on promote/activate/verify, not only issue:ingest (#3355).** `acceptance_stamp` emits when `plan.acceptance` is first written or materially changed on those verbs. `verify:ac` emits an `acceptance` outcome on every terminal path (config-error, soft-missing, soft-empty, run-pass, run-fail). Closes #3355. Refs #3323, #3334, #3360, #3282.
- **Origin freshness is fail-closed at `xbrief:preflight` (#3363).** When an origin-linked brief's live GitHub `updated_at` is newer than `xBRIEFInfo.updated`, preflight exits 1 and names re-read body+comments then dispose -- it does not auto-write origin onto the brief. All GitHub issue URLs in Origin/description are freshness-checked, not only the first. Refinement/sync prose now matches `reconcile:issues` (no stale-content bucket). Closes #3363.
- **scope:complete then check no longer vacates the done-gate (#3357).** `scope:complete` runs the verify:ac walk as a hard precondition on the completing brief and fails closed on empty or failing acceptance (item disposition is not a substitute). Check composition still uses `--soft-missing-xbrief` when no story was active this session, but a same-session complete targets the just-completed brief under `xbrief/completed` instead of skipping. One remediation string when that target cannot be read. Closes #3357. Refs #3334, #3267, #3284.
- **Hand-authored briefs run #3323 clause derivation on activate/promote (#3360).** When `plan.acceptance` is absent, empty-with-none_stated, or command-only-without-clauses, `scope:activate` / `scope:promote` decompose Overview/task-statement narratives, stamp `clauses[]` with `ambiguous`/`readings`/`chosen_reading`, and emit `acceptance_stamp`. The #3334 remedy names that derive step. Headless: records a chosen reading, never a blocking question. Closes #3360. Refs #3323, #3334, #3355, #3351.
- **UAT Shell residual after #3336: further write bins plus slices.jsonl leaf diversion (#3354).** Under active UAT, residual bins (`nc`/`netcat`/`7zz`/`msgfmt`/`msgcat`/`lz4`/`lzop`/`unrar`/`rar`/`aunpack`/`atool`/`ftpget`/`tftp`/`sqlite3`/`crane`/`objcopy`) that write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Dest flags cover `-o`/`--output`/`--outfile` and 7zz attached `-oDIR`; unknown write-shaped dest flags targeting those paths also fail closed. `slices.jsonl` append routes through `containedWrite` so a leaf symlink cannot divert the write. Ordinary non-authz dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. Already-denied `ncat`/`7z`/`msguniq` peers stay denied. Closes #3354. Refs #3336, #3288, #3039.
- **Run-summary seq lock reclaims only dead or unknown owners (#3361).** `.seq.lock` stores a pid+nonce token. A waiter does not delete a live holder's lock by mtime. Release unlinks only when the token still matches this holder. Fail-open after the bounded wait is unchanged (#3282). Residual of #3350. Closes #3361. Refs #3353, #3350, #3282.
- **Run-summary file-destination seq continues across CLI processes (#3350).** A new emitter that appends to an existing `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` JSONL seeds `seq` from the current line count, so N events across processes are `1..N`. Concurrent writers serialize count-then-append with a sibling lock; abandoned locks are reclaimed when the owner process is dead or the token is unreadable (#3361). Stdout destination stays per-process. Closes #3350. Refs #3320, #3282.

## [0.102.0] - 2026-08-13

> Rung-2 derived AC, product-oracle integrity, Blacksmith unclaimed failover, and the #3313-#3340 growing-cohort land since v0.101.0.

### Added

- **Rung-2 derived AC: clause decompose at intake, walk at done (#3323).** When no shell commands are stated, intake derives numbered independently testable clauses from the task statement onto `plan.acceptance.clauses[]` (`none_stated: true`, `source_rung: derived`) before the first product edit. Ambiguous clauses record both readings and the chosen one. `verify:ac` walks every clause against the shipped artifact at its stated path (verified / unverifiable / failed); unverifiable is reported, never dropped; done reports lead with failed/unverifiable. Run-summary adds `acceptance_stamp` (rung, none_stated, command/clause count) and carries rung + per-clause outcomes on the verify:ac `acceptance` sibling. `schema_version` stays 1. Does not change rung 1 or rung 3. Closes #3323. Refs #3284, #3267, #3334, #3322, #3320, #3282.

- **Product-oracle gate integrity (#3322).** A red product verification may be resolved only by a product change or an independently re-derived oracle. Run-summary `verification` events record `{check_id, method_fingerprint, outcome}`; `fail` then method-change then `pass` on one check id is flagged. `verify:ac` fails closed unless `independent_rederivation` is recorded. Build + pre-pr MUST/⊗ via pack source. Extends #3156. Closes #3322. Refs #3282, #3319, #3320, #1006, #3265.

- **Named cause for the 0.92→0.99 hard-task regression (#3321).** Default merge-ready (#3153) inserted the post-product verify-to-ship gap; ceremony dial + deposit-as-project (#3214) and the #3145 consumer-check trio lengthen that tail. #3225 is not the inserter. Amends the 0.99 #3282 turn-sink-as-cause conclusion. Gates kept (#3156). Follow-up #3325. Closes #3321.

- **Overlap dispose via `decision:write` + list-before-recommend (#3315).** Portfolio-priority documents human overlap-cluster dispose (every member in `relatedIssues`, required `revisitTrigger`) and parks already-disposed pairs after `task decision:list -- --issue N`. Dedicated ledger deferred until a pass re-litigates despite a dispose record (#3310). Closes #3315. Refs #3310.

### Changed

- **Retire the coverageDebt/checkResume consent ritual; keep two plain settings (#3314).** Session-start no longer quizzes Strict / Hatch-aware / Later. `policy:coverage-check-resume-preset|later|dismiss` and the nudge/preset modules are gone. `coverageDebt.mode` and `checkResume.localStamp` stay as optional fail-closed fields (default off). Interactive mutation ritual prints one disclosure line when either is non-default. Hatch and local stamp are reserved; live hatch is `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` (#2866). Closes #3314. Refs #3189, #3187, #2866.

### Fixed

- **Blacksmith failover no longer skips while required jobs are unclaimed; merge-gate gets a GH-hosted twin (#3340).** Unclaimed means no `runner_name`. `started_at` or a reusable-workflow caller `in_progress` is not a claim. The capacity arm waits the stall budget, then cancels unclaimed TypeScript, Go, and merge-gate primaries and arms GH-hosted failover. The required merge-gate aggregator can go green on the twin. Same-run rerun re-evaluates the arm. Claimed runners are still never cancelled (#2652). Closes #3340. Refs #2672, #3168, #2652, #3333.

- **Empty verify:ac is not a green run when there is no suite floor (#3334).** Zero-command resolution reports `soft_empty`/`skipped` with cause and stamp-acceptance remedy; check records it as degraded, not a bare `status: run`. `scope:activate` refuses Test / AcceptanceCriteria / Verification narratives without `plan.acceptance`. Run-summary `acceptance` events distinguish verified-pass from empty-pass. Closes #3334. Refs #3284, #3265, #1006, #3322.

- **verify:ac fails closed on stdout run-summary dest (#3322).** `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH=-` evaluates the in-process verification attempts from this invocation instead of treating non-file dest as no evidence. File dest still reads the file; unset dest stays fail-open/silent.

- **CLI-native check gates run without go-task in consumer deposits (#3335).** `deft check` dispatches `verify:*` (and sibling CLI verbs) through the global CLI when go-task is absent. Preflight reports a missing task binary as `impact: none` with no install-go-task remedy when every composed gate is CLI-dispatchable. Orientation `cache_fresh` in deposits names a bootstrap cause (`dirty`) instead of a generic `error`. Does not change what check composes (#3284). Closes #3335. Refs #3282, #3324.

- **Go installer plants the #3324 consumer-deposit marker on `.deft/core` and `--legacy-layout` `deft/` (#3331).** After vendor or upgrade, `deft-install` writes `.deft-consumer-deposit` into the deposit root so `engine:invoke` does not treat a source-looking tarball as buildable framework source. Engine dispatch honor stays on #3324. Genuine source checkouts are unchanged. Refs #3324, #3329, #3282, #2022.

- **Run-summary emits a tool/turn denominator so #3286 Later share is evaluable (#3320).** The #3282 stream now carries `total_tool_turns` (event `tool_turn_denominator`, or harness env `DEFT_TOTAL_TOOL_TURNS` stamped onto production events). `eval:report` prints ritual+gate share when that field is present and **trigger unevaluable** when it is absent — it does not invent a ratio from check counts. Emitter stays fail-open when `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` is unset. Closes #3320. Refs #3286, #3282, #3265.

- **Ceremony-dial escalation evaluations emit a run-summary event (#3319).** Every evaluation records tier, outcome (`escalated`|`declined`), and reason so a decline is distinct from never-evaluated. Session-start surfaces start-tier provenance; an external or operator pin states that #3274 cold-start selection is bypassed and names unset-the-pin as remediation. Emitter stays fail-open when `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` is unset. Does not change thresholds or the default tier. Closes #3319. Refs #3282, #3274, #3263, #3214.

- **Consumer-deposit marker forces global-CLI dispatch for every verb (#3324).** `@deftai/directive-content` now carries `deftConsumerDeposit: true` (also a `.deft-consumer-deposit` file, the content-package name, or a gitless `.deft/core` DEFT_ROOT so Go source-tarball deposits are not misclassified as buildable source; a source checkout with `.git` at that path still self-builds). When the marker is present, `engine:invoke` never treats the tree as buildable source: every verb resolves the global `deft`/`directive` CLI, and a missing CLI fails closed with `npm i -g @deftai/directive` (exit 2) instead of corepack/pnpm/`task build`. Runtime-verb whitelist remains for true source checkouts. Does not change what `check` composes (#3284). Closes #3324. Refs #3282, #2022, #2409.

- **Rule Authority and Thin Fail-Closed now reachable from agent entry surfaces (#3313).** Pointer-sufficient citations in agents-entry, preamble, and refreshed managed AGENTS.md. Contract markers gate both headers. Does not copy main.md bodies. Closes #3313.

- **UAT Shell residual after #3311: further write bins plant authz grants and kill-switch (#3336).** Under active UAT, residual bins (`oras`/`lwp-download`/`ncat`/`patch`/`base32`/`lrzip`/`unar`/`cabextract`/`ditto`/`dpkg-deb`/`hg`/`msguniq`) that write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Dest flags cover `-o`/`--output`/`--outfile`/`-output-directory` and cabextract `-d`; positional dests cover ditto/dpkg-deb/hg/lwp-download. Ordinary non-authz dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. Already-denied `gpg2`/`rage`/`xh`/`wcurl`/`curl` peers stay denied. Closes #3336. Refs #3311, #3288, #3039.

- **UAT Shell residual after #3288: versioned/alt write bins plant authz grants and kill-switch (#3311).** Under active UAT, residual bins (`gpg2`/`gpg1`/`rage`/`xh`/`httpie`/`wcurl`/`curlie`/`uudecode`/`iconv`/`gtar`/`star`/`gnutar`/`pax`) that write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Dest flags cover `-o`/`--output`/`--output-file`/`--download-dir` and tar-family `-C`. Ordinary non-authz dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. Already-denied `gpg`/`age`/`http`/`curl`/`tar` peers stay denied. Closes #3311. Refs #3288, #3245, #3039.

## [0.101.0] - 2026-08-12

> Product-first done-gate, orientation compression, AC-pass banking, structural grant CLI, SCM mirror discovery, session coda, and evidence schema alignment since v0.100.0.

### Added

- **Optional deterministic session coda on interactive doctor success (#2712).** After the final human success footer (`System check passed!` / warnings footer), interactive TTY doctor (exit 0, not CI, not `--json`) may print one extra operator line controlled by env-only `DEFT_SESSION_CODA`: **unset** → fixed discoverability `Session coda: off (set DEFT_SESSION_CODA=1 to enable)`; **`=1`** → exactly one `✦ <coda>` from content pack `content/doctor/session-coda.json` (deterministic FNV-1a of UTC date + project root); **`=0`** → silent. Never on hard fail; never mid-run `Next command:`; never JSON/AGENTS/skills; pack load fail omits star without failing doctor. Documented in `doctor --help`. Operator UX / agent-experience only — no new CLI verb, no USER.md key, no exit-code or Next-command changes. Closes #2712.
- **Consumer issue-label kit: optional `security` project routing label (#3299).** Documents optional portable `security` for advisory security review routing when a project uses that path — create on forge only if used; catalog in consumer `.github/ISSUE_LABELS.md`; not Core always-recommend; not a merge gate or maintainer AppSec taxonomy import. Source: `content/docs/consumer-issue-label-kit.md` (deposit on release). Closes #3299. Refs #2611, #2609.
- **Operator discovery for SCM label mirror (#3124).** Cold `session:start` / `triage:welcome` surfaces a throttled tip (until first successful `--mirror` dry-run or `triage:classify -- --ack-discovery` — not every re-arm) that teaches existence **and** get-the-most: dry-run first, defaults only stamp `triaged` on matches (control stamp), board usability needs full five-chip `actionLabels`, match rate needs `triageAutoClassify`, never auto-accept, policy:show + PROJECT-DEFINITION location, GitHub labels must exist, re-enrich warning, pointer to consumer kit #2611. Dry-run digests hint when `actionLabels` is empty or open `no_match` dominates. Agent anti-swallow rule requires user-visible restatement when the tip fires. Core: `packages/core/src/triage/classify/mirror-discovery-tip.ts`; welcome + classify digest + CLI dry-run throttle and ack entry. Also fixes vitest-3 coverage-debt soft-pass forwarding via `DEFT_TS_LANE_COVERAGE_DEBT` (CAC rejects unknown CLI debt tokens). Closes #3124. Refs #1423, #2611, #3125, #3197, #2573, #2618.
- **`authz:grant` structural scope:decompose mint path (#3291).** Operator CLI accepts `--parent` + `--draft` (optional `--repo`, `--single-use`, expiry) and mints via `mintDecomposeStructuralApplyGrant` with digest/parent/target/worktree bindings — preserving TTY / controlling-terminal / `--confirm` / typed `mint` / agent+CI refuse / UAT refuse. Apply denies and help show the exact mint command. `applyDecomposition` threads resolved `repo` into both `evaluateDecomposeStructuralApply` calls (initial + under-lock). `--check` remains ungated. Closes #3291. Refs #3239, #3258.

- **AC-pass banking checkpoint — finalize on green; deepen only with surplus (#3285).** When stated acceptance criteria first pass, agents MUST FINALIZE (checkpoint the green state under .deft/ac-pass-banks/ and optional DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH bank-event JSONL) before any self-imposed deepening. Deepening requires remaining budget >= plan.policy.acPassBanking.surplusThreshold (default **20%** of max turns/cost; env DEFT_AC_PASS_SURPLUS_THRESHOLD) plus the absolute #3266 reserve. Post-bank out-of-scope findings are **reported, not chased** when surplus is insufficient (unless they regress stated AC). Sharpens #3266; composes product-first done-gate (#3284). Core: packages/core/src/session/ac-pass-banking.ts, packages/core/src/policy/ac-pass-banking.ts; skill: deft-directive-build. Closes #3285. Refs #3266, #3284, #3282, #1006, #3214, #1581.

- **Orientation compression Now (#3286 / #2899 dual-path).** `session:start` composes doctor + #3282 toolchain preflight as inline sections with per-section status lines; deposit-sha fingerprint (payload + templates + engine) for orientation telemetry; content-current `agents:refresh` prints one-line `unchanged - sha match`; live cache-fresh evaluate always runs; opt-in `--compact` / `DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT` for terse machine output (verbose remains default). #2176 read-only default unchanged. Dual-path Later (`deft orient`) stays **open** until run-summary telemetry shows ritual+gate share ≥ 25% after Now ships. Core: `packages/core/src/session/orientation-compression.ts`, `deposit-sha.ts`, `orientation-state.ts`. Closes Now deliverable of #3286. Refs #3282, #2176, #3214, #1149, #2899.
- **Product-first done-gate (#3284).** Stated acceptance criteria run **first** and are never skippable; hygiene gates run second and degrade under pressure. (1) `plan.acceptance.commands[]` schema with required `none_stated: true` when empty; AC-source ladder `stated` → `derived` → `project_floor` (probe lock). Intake stamps acceptance from #3267 capture. (2) `task verify:ac` / `deft verify:ac` runs commands verbatim (primary name; `verify:literal-ac` remains the #3267 mechanism). (3) `task check` composes `verify:ac` first (fail-fast) on framework and consumer lists; `--soft-missing-xbrief` avoids deadlock without an active story. (4) Pressure/degraded/hard-budget: hygiene advisory, AC still hard. (5) Ceremony dial rapid/minimal = AC-only check composition. Core: `packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/`; CLI: `verify-ac`; skills: build + pre-pr; strategy: rapid. Architecture for #3267. Closes #3284. Refs #3267, #973, #3214, #3266, #3156.
- **Done-gate toolchain preflight + opt-in run-summary telemetry (#3282).** Session start surfaces missing task/pnpm/node with cause and remedy; check failures name the gate, cause, and remedy; incomplete tooling yields a degraded skip report (exit 2, not green). Opt-in `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` JSONL (path, `-` stdout, or silent/unset). Closes #3282.

Bare `evidence` / `disposition` are missing/invalid for the acceptance-evidence gate (no permanent dual-read) and continue to fail `verify:vbrief-conformance`. `ITEM_CORE` is **not** expanded with bare evidence/disposition (reverts the short-lived bare-core allow from the #3124 complete land). ## [0.100.0] - 2026-08-11

> Literal acceptance verification, parent-lineage/decompose gates, effort budget, dual-stop follow-up, and lifecycle consistency since v0.99.0.

### Added

- **Literal acceptance-command verification (#3267).** At intake, capture exact stated shell acceptance commands into `plan.metadata.literal_acceptance_commands` (source=`task_statement`, no paraphrase). Agent-authored `swarm.verify_commands` / plan-item `command` run **verbatim** before done via `task verify:literal-ac` and `scope:complete` — fail closed on non-zero or unpromoted task_statement-only commands. Shell meta + first-token allowlist refuse closed; **wrapper verbs** (`task`/`deft`/`directive`) limited to `check|doctor|verify:*|help|--version` and package-manager `exec` to `vitest` only (no ambient scope/policy/scm). Safety-rejected shell-shaped lines persist on a **rejected ledger** (`literal_acceptance_rejected`) surfaced by verify/complete. Dedup preserves distinct `cwd`/`expectedExitCode`; reload keeps execution context; trailing path token `.` is not stripped as punctuation. `task_statement` is never auto-promoted into `swarm.verify_commands`. Self-chosen verification is supplementary only. Survives ceremony dial rapid/minimal (`literalAcceptanceRequired: true`; #3214 / #3156). Extends #973. Core: `packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/`; skills: build + pre-pr; strategy: rapid. Relates #3266. Closes #3267.
- **Operator follow-up after dual-stop / hard stop (#3273).** Named low-token section on `deft-directive-swarm` (thin SKILL + `references/core-phase-4.md` / `core-ops.md`) and `deft-directive-review-cycle`: one residual pass under operator consent, authorized conf floor this-PR-only, anti thrash (⊗ unlimited auto-retry). Mandatory halt-report resume line (residual class + pursue residual / follow-up hard-stop / same as conf-hold / continue dual-stopped PR + skill pointer) so agents discover resume without chat memory. When to Use triggers; content-contract markers; optional `commands.md` pointer. Portable consumer + maintainer. Does not lower `minGreptileConfidence` or allow parent self-implement (#2843). Closes #3273. Refs #2442, #3095, #3225, #2843.
- **story-ready and preflight verify parent requirement lineage (#3241).** When a child xBRIEF links a parent that authors stable requirement IDs (#3238), Gate 0 (`verify:story-ready`) and implementation preflight (`xbrief:preflight` / pre-PR) require `plan.metadata.parent_lineage` coverage artifacts (or equivalent `coverage_map` + `behavioral_deltas`). Missing coverage fails closed (`defect_class=child_spec`). Uncovered parent IDs, negative invariants omitted without `behavioral_delta`, and undeclared deltas fail closed (`defect_class=parent_child_drift`). Structure-only — reuses `validateCoverageMap`. Decompose stamps full parent lineage onto children. Emits `PARENT_LINEAGE` JSON. Core: `packages/core/src/scope/parent-lineage.ts` + `story-ready` / `preflight` / `decompose`. Closes #3241. Refs #3237, #3238.
- **Budget-aware effort sizing — bank the stated pass before deepening (#3266).** When a hard turn or cost budget is detectable (`DEFT_MAX_TURNS` / `DEFT_MAX_BUDGET` / aliases / host descriptor / `DEFT_HARD_BUDGET`), session:start surfaces `effort_budget` and bank-the-pass guidance. Agents prioritize stated acceptance criteria over self-imposed deeper verification; depth scales with remaining budget; skip-deepen is fail-loud (#1006). Success-side analog of dual-stop (#2442). Core: `packages/core/src/session/effort-budget.ts`; skill guidance in `deft-directive-build` and `deft-directive-pre-pr`. Closes #3266. Refs #2442, #1006, #1581, #3214, #1461.

- **Fail-closed completed-tracked land gate (#3264).** Closed scoped GitHub issues with a known lifecycle xBRIEF origin must have a *tracked* xbrief/completed/ or xbrief/cancelled/ artifact on the delivery tip (git ls-tree / git show). Catches completed-but-untracked laptop residue that verify:orphan-active and release active-folder sync miss. Verb: task verify:completed-tracked (standalone surface -- not on check:consumer / check:framework-source, so lifecycle land PRs are not deadlocked; pass --tip HEAD when validating an in-flight land branch). Fail message names task swarm:finalize-cohort or a lifecycle PR. Core: packages/core/src/lifecycle/completed-tracked-on-delivery.ts. Closes #3264. Refs #1358, #2321, #3262.
- **Thin fail-closed design rule in main.md (#3265).** Names design-time preference: one fail-closed deterministic check with one remediation; skill-only process closes are incomplete when a task/doctor/release gate can fail closed; prefer thin closable slices over boil-the-ocean first ships. Cross-links Rule Authority, #1200, #3156; examples #3237, #3264. Brief controlled English only; does not expand AGENTS.md managed section. Closes #3265.
- **scope:decompose requires parent-requirement coverage map for semantic fidelity (#3238).** When a parent authors stable requirement IDs, `--check` / apply validate a machine-readable `coverage_map` covering every ID with disposition `covered|deferred|split|behavioral_delta` and required side fields (deferred provenance, split_group+part completeness, `delta_id` → `behavioral_deltas` record). Negative invariants cannot be silently omitted; intentional change uses `behavioral_delta` (separate approval hook via linked delta record). Emits `COVERAGE_REPORT` JSON (`deft.decompose.coverage_report.v1`). Structure-only — no LLM semantic judgment. Fixtures: A→B→C ordered stages forbidding A→C. Core: `packages/core/src/scope/coverage-map.ts` + `decompose.ts`. Closes #3238. Refs #3237 Q1/Q7/Q8.

- **Completed lifecycle consistency verifier for folder/status/items (#3242).** Epic #3237 Q4 simple rule: `completed/` must match terminal `plan.status` (`completed|failed`), and every `plan.items` entry must be terminal (not `pending|proposed|running`). `scope:complete` fails closed after #3240 reconcile when the post-state still disagrees (exact artifact path + statuses). Doctor hard-fails on folder/status drift, unreadable/malformed completed artifacts, and uninspectable lifecycle roots; scans `xbrief/completed/` and read-accepted `vbrief/completed/` (including mixed roots; no green-skip). Open items under historical `completed/` are advisory (exit-exempt) until corpus backfill — new completes remain hard-gated. Core: `packages/core/src/lifecycle/completed-consistency.ts` + doctor `completed-lifecycle-consistency` / `completed-open-items` + `transition.ts` assert. Does not couple `history/changes`. Closes #3242. Refs #3237 Q4, #3240, #2862, #2578.

- **`scope:decompose` apply requires human-origin draft-digest grant (#3239).** Applying a decomposition draft now fails closed unless `.deft/authz` holds a human-origin grant for operation `scope.decompose.apply.structural` bound to project identity (repo and/or worktree), parent artifact path, draft/target path, and the SHA-256 of the exact draft bytes. Missing, expired, mismatched, incomplete, or agent-origin grants deny before any child story writes. `--check` stays ungated. Mint helper: `mintDecomposeStructuralApplyGrant`. Core: `packages/core/src/authz/decompose-apply.ts` + `packages/core/src/scope/decompose.ts`. Closes #3239. Refs #3237 Q2, #2944.
- **`scope:complete` requires typed evidence or human disposition per acceptance criterion (#3240).** Non-terminal `plan.items` (and nested `subItems`/`items`) no longer auto-complete from merge ancestry alone. Each criterion needs either `evidence` (`kind` in `test|review|merge|deploy|smoke|uat|observed_behavior` + `pointer` + `recorded_at` + `recorded_by`) or `disposition` (`waived|deferred|not_applicable` + `reason` + human-origin `provenance` + `recorded_at`). `merge`/`review` alone cannot satisfy smoke/UAT/deploy/observed_behavior criteria (inferred from title/Acceptance text or explicit `requires`/`acceptanceAxis`). Fail-closed lists missing criteria; success output lists evidence/disposition per item. Core: `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts` + `transition.ts` gate. Closes #3240. Refs #3237 Q3, #3041, #2862.

### Changed

- **Land completed xBRIEFs for closed 2026-08-10 cohort issues.** Product already merged; lifecycle artifacts for #3233–#3236, #3239–#3240, #3242–#3243, #3245–#3246, #3252, #3259 move into tracked `xbrief/completed/` with terminal `plan.status`/items (capacity + completedAt stamps). No product code. Refs #2321, #2578, #3242.

### Fixed

- **UAT Shell residual after #3245: crypto/alt-download bins + sibling JSONL symlink append (#3288).** Under active UAT, residual write bins (`gpg`/`age`/`zstd`/`sftp`/`wget2`/`http`/`yt-dlp`/`aria2`/`mbuffer`/`cpio`) that plant into `.deft/authz/**` or kill-switch basenames classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Dest flags cover `-o`/`--output`/`-D` and bin-specific forms; prior #3206/#3213/#3245 cases stay denied. Triage sibling JSONL writers (`summary-history`, reconcile audit, bootstrap audit) route appends through `containedWrite` so leaf symlink follow cannot divert into tracked files. Closes #3288. Refs #3245, #3213, #3206, #3039, #2980.

- **Ceremony dial cold-start is tier-conditional (#3263).** Incomplete size no longer always starts `rapid`: mid/low model tiers cold-start at `standard` (structure floor); frontier and unknown tier stay `rapid`. Escalate-on-evidence (provisional M/L, full matrix) unchanged. Audit path: `readCeremonyDialAudit` / `formatCeremonyDialAuditLine` read depth + provisional reasons already recorded on `.deft/ritual-state.json` `ceremony_dial` at session:start. Core: `packages/core/src/policy/ceremony-dial.ts`. Closes #3263. Refs #3214, #1581, #759.

- **Cursor ephemeral local-dev Task no longer needs a fake active xBRIEF (#3259).** Session assist env (`DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE` assist-set / `DEFT_HOOK_ASSIST=1`) is a structural ephemeral marker for **spawn tools only** (shared taxonomy with #1802 / #3080); implement envelope signals still win. Spawn-not-ready recovery and `commands.md` state free-text `[worker_role: ephemeral]` is not sufficient and name parent Shell + session assist as Cursor local-dev paths. Unmarked Multitask without assist still denies. Closes #3259. Refs #3080, #1802.

- **scope:decompose single-use claim is failure-safe and crash-recoverable (#3239 residual).** Structural apply holds an exclusive grant claim lock through revalidate → mark `usedAt` → multi-file child/parent writes; apply throw rolls `usedAt` back under the lock (retry-safe) and best-effort removes this attempt's child files. Dead-PID/corrupt locks reclaim via rename-away (not blind `rmSync`) then exclusive create; live holder PIDs are never reclaimed. Refs #3239, #3237.

- **scope:decompose --check rejects size=large with parallel_safe=true (#3252).** Decomposition check now matches swarm readiness: large work cannot be marked concurrent, so approved drafts stay allocatable. Closes #3252. Refs #3237.

- **Doctor fails closed on project xBRIEF envelope major behind the framework (#3243).** Live-path scan (PROJECT-DEFINITION + `xbrief/{pending,active}/*.xbrief.json`): when declared envelope major is behind the framework target (e.g. `0.6` vs `0.8`), `xbrief-envelope-version` errors with both versions named and next action `deft migrate:xbrief` (aligns with hybrid in-place rewrite #3236). Non-migratable behind-major (null/`0.5`/unreadable/malformed/unlistable lifecycle dir) fails with actionable next steps (fix FS permissions; re-emit full xBRIEFInfo via scope tools; migrate only for exact 0.6; delete/replace invalid artifacts after human confirm — not a false migrate-only or version-only bump). Stat probes distinguish ENOENT (absent) from EACCES/EPERM/other (unreadable) so unstatable PROJECT-DEFINITION and pending/active folders cannot silent-skip. Existing `pending`/`active` dirs that cannot be enumerated fail closed (directory path entry; not silent greenfield skip). Mixed 0.6 + non-migratable reports both remediations in one fail. All scanned envelopes at framework major pass; behind-minor does not fail this check. Proposed/completed/cancelled archives are not fail-closed in this first ship. Epic #3237 Q5 Option 2 (envelope major only). Core: `packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts`, `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts`. Closes #3243. Refs #2971, #3236, #3237.

- **Session ritual detects a stale higher-precedence CLI after global upgrade (#3233).** After gated ritual entrypoints, Directive resolves every PATH candidate for bare `deft` / `directive`, probes each engine version, and fails closed when the shell-active binary is older than another install or does not match the upgrade target. The failure lists competing executable paths/versions and PATH/prefix remediation instead of recording a successful upgrade while a shadowed Homebrew (or other) prefix still wins. Core: `packages/core/src/session/active-cli.ts`, `packages/core/src/doctor/which.ts` (`whichAll`), verify-session-ritual gated wire-up. Closes #3233.
- **Cursor preToolUse deposit timeout raised so gated ritual is not host failClosed exit-1 (#3246).** Cursor `tool.before` deposits used `timeout: 5` with `failClosed: true`. Mutation Task/spawn paths re-run live agent-hook readiness (multi-host ceiling ~12s), so a normal ritual could exceed the host budget and surface only opaque exit-1 with no Directive allow/deny code. Deposit default is now `CURSOR_TOOL_BEFORE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (30); inspect treats legacy `timeout: 5` as drifted so `init`/`update` repairs. Active-xBRIEF implement gate (#3080) and clean deny without active xBRIEF unchanged. Session start/compact stay at 5s. Refs #2864, #3080.

- **UAT Shell residuals after #3213: archive/alt-downloaders + kill-switch plant; triage-cache symlink append (#3245).** Under active UAT, archive extractors (`tar`/`bsdtar`/`unzip`/`7z`) and alternate downloaders (`rclone`/`axel`/`fetch`/`socat`/`lftp`) that write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant kill-switch basenames (`.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`) classify as settings deny (not unclassifiable allow). Dest flags cover `-C`/`--directory`/`-d`/`-o`/`OPEN:` forms; prior #3206/#3213 curl/scp/ln cases stay denied. Triage-cache `candidates.jsonl` append routes through `containedWrite` so in-tree leaf symlink follow cannot divert audit lines into tracked files. Closes #3245. Refs #3206, #3213, #3039, #2980.

- **Head-bound merge approval invalidates when PR HEAD changes (#3235).** Phase 5 → 6 `plan:approved` now participates in merge gates as an exact-head authorization: when `approved_head_sha != current_head_sha` (including multi-push auto-merge retention), `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` and `pr:finish-loop` fail closed, best-effort disable GitHub auto-merge (`gh pr merge --disable-auto`), and print recovery that requires a fresh `plan:approved` bound to the current head via `--head-sha`. Core: `packages/core/src/policy/merge-approval-head.ts` (+ cascade / finish-loop wiring). Does not change consumer repository rulesets. Closes #3235. Refs #1193, #635.

- **migrate:xbrief rewrites hybrid xBRIEFInfo@0.6 envelopes on already-xbrief trees (#3236).** When a project is already on `xbrief/` with no `vbrief/` but residual lifecycle artifacts still declare `xBRIEFInfo.version: "0.6"`, `migrate:xbrief` now applies `transformArtifactV06ToV08` in place (exit 0 with a rewrite report) instead of no-opping with the schemas-only `directive update` tip. Already-0.8 trees stay idempotent; deposited schema files under `xbrief/schemas/` remain the #2368 update path. Closes the gap left after #2974 (transform accepted hybrid, orchestrator did not rewrite). Refs #2970, #2974, #2368.

### Removed

## [0.99.0] - 2026-08-10

> Swarm retain/pre-dispatch + nuclear-family A2A, ceremony dial, decision log, effort XL gate, and related security/check fixes since v0.98.1.

### Added

- **Retained addressable sub-agents — message-later / steer-mid-flight (#3158).** Names retained-child mode beside dispatch-and-collect in swarm canon (`swarm/swarm.md`), swarm skill + Phase 3 classify, and per-host continue-by-id notes (Warp/OpenClaw retain when live; Cursor/Claude/Grok/generic default one-shot unless host documents resume). Capability-tiered mid-scope gate (#954): retain-capable hosts may single-dispatch with re-message; others keep split-dispatch. Always-on agents-entry pin + preamble §10; #3164 stance (orchestration not constitution self-edit); couples to landed #3155 nuclear-family topology (retain does not license open mesh). Closes #3158. Refs #2510, #673, #954, #3155, #3164, #3179, #1309.

- **Swarm pre-dispatch deny when unit already has an active implement leaf (#3228).** Wires #3143 `DENY_DUPLICATE_ACTIVE` (`maxActiveAttempts: 1`) onto the swarm re-dispatch path via `task swarm:pre-dispatch` (exit 0 allow / 1 active deny or gate block / 2 config). Default unit key: `scopeId` + `targetId` + `workflowId=drive-to:merge-ready`. Actions: `begin` (default, begins attempt on allow), `complete`, `cancel` (takeover = cancel then begin — not concurrent dual active). Skill/preamble pointer only; CLI is authoritative. Core: `packages/core/src/swarm/pre-dispatch.ts`. Closes #3228. Refs #3143, #261, #263.

- **Gate-integrity rule — failing gate must not be fixed by editing the gate (#3156).** Sharp product/process rule: fix loops MUST NOT clear red by mutating the gate definition, verifier, reward, required check, coverage floor, policy flag, or eval fixture; fix the work under test, or change gates via issue/PR + review (#3164 constitution-tier disposal). Explicit separation from #2436 refine-internal SkillOpt stack; Factorio / Continual Harness evidence pointer; parent epic #3179. Discoverability via pre-pr Diff checklist + anti-pattern and always-on `agents-entry` pointer (`task agents:refresh`; not full CI automation). Docs: `content/docs/gate-integrity.md`; pointers in `main.md`, philosophy, verification, goal-gate-determinism, host-surface-assumptions. Ratchet: `plan.policy.agentsMdBudget` raised for the managed pointer (compose with #3155 nuclear-family budget). Closes #3156. Refs #782, #1499, #3145, #2436, #3164, #3179, #1200, #645.
- **Nuclear-family A2A topology — bounded agent-messaging graph (#3155).** Swarm canon names Communication Topology: agent-to-agent messaging limited to parent / sibling (same cohort) / child; open mesh across cohorts or sessions is forbidden. Security taxonomy records unbounded A2A graphs as an attack-surface multiplier. ADR-003 accepts the bounded-graph posture as decision input to #2705 and explicitly defers the remaining A2A client-posture ADR work to #2705. Always-on managed AGENTS pointer via `content/templates/agents-entry.md` + agents:refresh (#1309); `plan.policy.agentsMdBudget` managedMaxLines 135→145 and absoluteMaxBytes 12000→13000 for the pointer growth. Cross-links #3158 (retained children; runtime out of scope) and parent epic #3179. Docs/rule only — not full A2A protocol. Sources: `content/packs/swarm-spec/swarm-spec-pack-0.1.json` → `content/swarm/swarm.md`; `content/meta/security.md`; `docs/decisions/ADR-003-a2a-nuclear-family-topology.md`. Closes #3155. Refs #2705, #3158, #3179, #480, #1309, #645.

- **Advisory reviewer verdicts block mechanical merge-readiness (#3225).** `pr:merge-ready` / `pr:watch` / the shared greptile detector now parse should-not-merge / not-safe-to-merge (and related) prose from bot comment bodies and treat it as a hard block independent of formal Changes-Requested or GitHub Ready-to-merge. Matching is scoped to Confidence Score / Summary / Decision regions so descriptive overview mentions of the detector phrases do not false-block. Composes with `minGreptileConfidence` (#3095). Review-cycle + swarm merge-path skills state mechanical mergeability is necessary, never sufficient. Closes #3225. Refs #3095, #1282, #1101, #2308, #1004.


- **PlanItem effort estimate S/M/L/XL with time anchors (#1581).** Optional `effort` enum on plan items (schema + TypeScript types): S under 2h, M half-day 2-4h, L 1-2 days, XL needs breakdown. Docs in `vbrief/vbrief.md`. `scope:activate` / `vbrief:activate` fail closed while any nested item still has `effort: "XL"`. Build/swarm/refinement skill guidance sizes agents and prompts for estimate. Omitted field still validates. Closes #1581.

- **Ceremony dial — two-stage ritual depth by size × tier × shape (#3214).** Typed `plan.policy.ceremonyDial` selects session ritual / gate depth: **cold-start / incomplete inputs → rapid** (start light; no #1581 plan-item deadlock); escalate when evidence arrives (provisional M/L, mid/low tier, full matrix).
